title: The West Inn | 4BR Beach Rental on 30A | Royal Destinations
meta_description: The West Inn is a luxury 4BR Blue Mountain Beach home in a gated community. Enjoy community pool access and lake views. This 30A rental sleeps 12. Reserve today!
description_expanded: Description: The West Inn by Royal Destinations Location: Blue Mountain Beach Address: 260 Old Beach Road, Santa Rosa Beach, FL Details: Located in 30A’s Gulf-front community of Old Florida Beach, The West Inn offers close proximity to beach access along with a large community pool inside the gates of this highly sought-after neighborhood. This 30A luxury vacation rental spans nearly 4,500 square feet and features two spacious living rooms, giving families the flexibility to gather together or spread out and unwind in comfort. The West Inn is a 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home ideally situated between the village centers of Blue Mountain Beach and Dune Allen Beach, placing guests in the heart of the Emerald Coast with something for everyone to enjoy. Perched high above the shimmering emerald waters, The West Inn offers front-row access to one of the best sunset views along Scenic Highway 30A. This luxury residence features all ensuite accommodations, an open floor plan, two living areas, and a premier location that consistently ranks at the top of guests’ wish lists. From the moment you enter the gates, the community and home embody the quintessential seaside lifestyle. Perfect for extended families or groups of friends, guests will appreciate having their own private retreats while still enjoying ample space for time together. Don’t wait to reserve your 30A getaway at The West Inn today. With an abundance of activities within walking distance, guests can fully enjoy the beach or explore Draper Lake, one of the area’s rare coastal dune lakes, ideal for kayaking, paddleboarding, and fishing. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Just a 2-minute walk to sugar-white sand beach access. - Rare lake access directly across the street, perfect for paddleboarding and kayaking. - Exclusive Gulf-front gated community offering privacy and security. - Expansive community pool, heated in the spring and fall for year-round enjoyment. - Ample parking with space for up to 4 vehicles in the private driveway. - Six adult bikes included for effortless cruising along Scenic Highway 30A. - Outdoor pizza oven for unforgettable al fresco dining nights. - High-speed wireless internet, ideal for streaming, remote work, and staying connected. - Premium clean linen program. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 4 Beds / 4.5 Baths First Floor: - Guest Bedroom 1: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower - Guest Bedroom 2: Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed, Detached Bathroom with Shower - Family Room, Lower-Level Kitchen and Bar Area, Queen Sleeper Second Floor: - Guest Bedroom 3: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Soaking Tub - Open Floor Plan Living Room, Dining Room, Kitchen, Bar Seating, Half Bathroom - Outdoor Dining - Laundry Room Third Floor: - Guest Bedroom 4: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Soaking Tub Please Note: *Nearby construction is underway. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. *Weddings are not permitted at this home. *Due to the meandering tree-lined roads and the quaint neighborhood, this is a non-golf cart rental community. *Smoking is not permitted on or near this property. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
